test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Looking at the family picture, Amit said, "He is my wife's father's son's only sister's father-in-law.' How is the person in the photo related to Amit?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68649cacfa98245f0ceb36f716a73c5c632a9f59d024076540dec2107071feb2.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7d2c089aa207a7e775896362b31696f39228042e40ee578efa8915554fd8ff5.png] 

He is my wife's father's son's only sister's is Amit's wife itself.

And father-in-law of Amit's wife is Father of Amit.

Clearly, the person in the photo is father of Amit.

Hence, '**Father**' is the correct answer.
